products.name: Watches
products.description: Designs, sources, markets, and distributes a wide range of watches under owned and licensed brands, spanning luxury, accessible luxury, and fashion categories. Products are manufactured by independent contractors in Switzerland and Asia using Swiss or non-Swiss movements and components.

products.name: Jewelry
products.description: Designs, sources, markets, and distributes fashion and some fine jewelry under several owned and licensed brands. Jewelry is manufactured by independent contractors, primarily in Asia, and marketed through the same channels as watches.

products.name: Other Fashion Accessories
products.description: Designs, sources, markets, and distributes other fashion accessories, such as sunglasses, under certain brands. These are ancillary to the core watch and jewelry business and are distributed through similar channels.

products.name: After-Sales Service and Warranty Repairs
products.description: Provides after-sales service, warranty repairs, and maintenance for its watches and jewelry through company-owned and authorized service centers worldwide. Services are delivered both directly and via a web-based system for customers and retail partners.

products.name: Retail Outlet Stores
products.description: Operates retail outlet stores and an online outlet store selling current and discontinued models of watches, jewelry, and accessories directly to consumers. These stores serve as a direct sales channel for the company's products.

products.name: National Security and Defense Engineering and Support Services
products.description: Comprehensive engineering, technical, and operational support services for defense, intelligence, space, and aviation programs, including systems engineering, rapid prototyping, test and evaluation, C5ISR, cyber analytics, and program management. Delivered primarily to government agencies through a mix of in-person, on-site, and digital solutions under long-term contracts.

products.name: Space Operations and Human Spaceflight Services
products.description: Operational expertise and support for space domain awareness, human spaceflight, satellite operations, and related mission planning, delivered through a combination of technical labor, digital systems, and regulated infrastructure for government and commercial clients.

products.name: Integrated Supply Chain and Logistics Services
products.description: Integrated supply chain management, logistics, and military aviation support services, involving in-person labor, asset management, and digital tracking for government and defense clients.

products.name: Cybersecurity and Digital Information Operations Solutions
products.description: Advanced digital solutions including cyber analytics, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data analytics, and virtual/augmented reality technical training, delivered as digital-only or hybrid services to government and commercial clients.

products.name: Scientific Research and Technical Services
products.description: Scientific research and technical services in quantum science, computing, health and human performance, materials science, life sciences, and earth sciences, delivered through specialized technical labor and laboratory infrastructure for government and commercial clients.

products.name: Process Technology Licensing and Proprietary Equipment
products.description: Licensing of proprietary, sustainability-focused process technologies and provision of related proprietary equipment, catalysts, and integration services for the production of energy, chemicals, and specialty products. Delivered through technology transfer, engineering, and equipment supply to industrial clients.

products.name: Engineering, Design, and Project Management for Energy and Industrial Markets
products.description: High-end engineering, design, and project management services focused on energy security, decarbonization, energy transition, asset optimization, and environmental impact, delivered through professional labor, digital tools, and regulated project execution for industrial and government clients.

products.name: Advisory and Consulting Services for Energy Transition and Critical Infrastructure
products.description: Professional advisory and consulting services across defense, renewable energy, and critical infrastructure sectors, with a focus on energy transition, net-zero carbon solutions, and asset optimization. Delivered through expert consulting teams and digital analysis.

products.name: Circular Economy and Plastics Recycling Technologies
products.description: Licensing and implementation of proprietary technologies for plastics recycling and circular economy solutions, such as Hydro-PRTTM, enabling conversion of waste plastics into virgin-grade feedstocks. Delivered through technology licensing, engineering, and equipment supply to industrial clients.

products.name: Ammonia and Hydrogen Energy Solutions
products.description: Provision and licensing of proprietary ammonia and hydrogen production technologies, including green ammonia solutions (K-GreeNTM), for industrial and energy clients. Delivered through technology licensing, engineering, and equipment supply.

products.name: Sustainable Aviation Fuel and Decarbonization Technologies
products.description: Licensing and implementation of proprietary sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and decarbonization technologies (e.g., PureSAFSM), supporting clients in reducing emissions in the aviation sector. Delivered through technology transfer, engineering, and equipment supply.

products.name: Connected Fitness Equipment
products.description: Peloton designs, manufactures, and sells premium connected fitness hardware including the Peloton Bike, Bike+, Tread, Tread+, and Row, which integrate technology and media to deliver interactive workout experiences at home or in commercial settings. These products are produced using a combination of third-party manufacturing and vertically integrated refurbishment.

products.name: Digital Fitness and Wellness Content Subscriptions
products.description: Peloton offers paid digital memberships that provide access to a vast library of instructor-led fitness and wellness classes, training programs, and interactive features via its hardware or standalone Peloton Apps, delivered through proprietary software platforms. Content is produced in studio environments and accessed on-demand or live via digital devices.

products.name: Peloton Apps (Mobile and TV Applications)
products.description: Peloton develops and sells app-based fitness solutions (App+, App One, Strength+) that allow users to access classes and features on mobile devices, tablets, computers, and TVs, independent of owning Peloton hardware. These are digital-only products delivered via app stores and subscriptions.

products.name: Business-to-Business Fitness Solutions
products.description: Peloton provides B2B fitness and well-being solutions, including connected fitness equipment, app access, and engagement-based offerings, to commercial clients such as hotels, residential buildings, gyms, corporations, and healthcare providers. These solutions integrate Peloton’s hardware, software, and content into client environments.

products.name: Fitness Equipment Rental Program
products.description: Peloton offers a rental program allowing customers to rent select connected fitness equipment (e.g., Bike+) bundled with access to fitness content for a monthly fee. This service is available in select markets and includes equipment delivery and ongoing access to digital content.

products.name: In-Person Studio Fitness Experiences
products.description: Peloton operates physical studios in New York and London where members can participate in live, instructor-led fitness classes and events, combining a high-energy production environment with in-person engagement. These experiences are produced and delivered by Peloton staff in dedicated facilities.

products.name: Satellite Modems and Amplifiers
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and supports advanced, software-defined satellite modems, high-power amplifiers (SSPAs, TWTAs), and frequency converters for GEO, MEO, and LEO satellite constellations. Delivered as physical hardware with supporting network management software, primarily for defense, commercial, and government customers.

products.name: Troposcatter Communication Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and delivers next-generation, software-defined troposcatter terminals and systems for secure, long-distance (up to 200 miles) transmission of digitized voice, video, and data. Delivered as ruggedized hardware systems for military, defense, and select commercial sectors.

products.name: Cybersecurity Training Services
products.description: Provides advanced, mission-critical cybersecurity training programs and tools, primarily for U.S. government, commercial, and university customers. Delivered both on customer sites and via hosted SaaS platforms, leveraging proprietary training methods and administration portals.

products.name: Space Components and Antennas
products.description: Delivers high-reliability electronic components, antennas, and engineering services for satellite and space programs, including kitting, supply chain management, and failure analysis. Products are manufactured and tested to meet stringent mission/project requirements for agencies like NASA and international space organizations.

products.name: Next-Generation 911 (NG-911) Solutions
products.description: Provides emergency call routing, location validation, network integration, policy-based routing, logging, and security for state and local governments and telecom carriers. Delivered as integrated software and hardware systems, including ESInet connectivity and compliance with FCC mandates.

products.name: 911 Call Handling Solutions
products.description: Offers comprehensive 911 call handling applications and platforms (e.g., Guardian), including integrated call and text-to-911, conferencing, analytics, and geospatial display for Public Safety Answering Points (PSAPs). Delivered as on-premise or cloud-based software solutions, with options for hosted '911-as-a-Service'.

products.name: Carrier Location and Messaging Services
products.description: Provides software and equipment enabling mobile network operators and government agencies to deliver accurate device location, text messaging, and geo-targeted public alerts. Solutions support 2G-5G networks and include operational support, system optimization, and maintenance.

products.name: Public Safety Situational Awareness Platforms
products.description: Delivers cloud-based platforms (e.g., SmartResponse) that aggregate and present real-time multimedia data, mapping, and analytics to first responders and emergency agencies. Enables integrated operational views, live feeds, and data-driven response capabilities.

products.name: Well Construction Services
products.description: Comprehensive services and products supporting new wellbore drilling, completion, recompletion, and plug and abandonment, including tubular running, cementing, drilling tools, and wellbore cleanup. Delivered through physical equipment, advanced technology, and on-site labor in both onshore and offshore environments.

products.name: Well Flow Management Services
products.description: Integrated systems and services for safe production, measurement, and sampling of hydrocarbons, including well testing, flowback, early production facilities, production enhancement, emissions management, and metering. Delivered via specialized equipment, field operations, and digital monitoring technologies.

products.name: Subsea Well Access Systems and Services
products.description: Provision of subsea well access solutions and systems for exploration, development, intervention, and abandonment, including Subsea Test Tree Assemblies, motion-compensating surface handling equipment, and intervention riser systems. Delivered through engineered hardware, project management, and integration services for offshore operations.

products.name: Well Intervention and Integrity Services
products.description: Services and technologies to acquire and interpret well data, maintain and restore wellbore integrity, and improve production, including mechanical and wireline interventions, chemical treatments, expandable casing patches, and advanced data acquisition. Delivered via specialized field crews, proprietary tools, and digital systems.

products.name: Private Aviation Membership Program
products.description: A subscription-based program providing members with access to a controlled fleet of private aircraft and benefits such as guaranteed availability, fixed or dynamic pricing, and premium services. Delivered via digital platforms and supported by physical aircraft operations and concierge-level service teams.

products.name: On-Demand Private Jet Charter Solutions
products.description: Pay-as-you-go private jet charter services for individuals and businesses, utilizing both Wheels Up's controlled fleet and a global network of third-party operators. Bookings are managed digitally and fulfilled through physical aircraft operations, offering bespoke arrangements for short- and long-haul flights.

products.name: Group Charter Services
products.description: Charter services for large passenger groups, such as sports teams, corporate events, and tour operations, leveraging both owned and third-party aircraft. Delivered through specialized charter brokers and aviation professionals.

products.name: Cargo Charter Services
products.description: On-demand air cargo transportation services for commercial, government, and defense clients, utilizing both controlled and third-party aircraft. Requires specialized aircraft and regulatory compliance for cargo operations.

products.name: Government and Defense Aviation Solutions
products.description: Specialized charter and aviation services for government and defense clients, including passenger and cargo transport, delivered through a combination of owned and third-party aircraft and subject to rigorous regulatory and safety standards.

products.name: Hybrid Private-Commercial Travel Solutions (Delta Partnership)
products.description: Integrated travel solutions combining private aviation with premium commercial airline services through a partnership with Delta Air Lines, enabling members to book and manage both private and commercial flights via a unified digital platform.

products.name: Lifestyle and Concierge Services for Members
products.description: A suite of premium lifestyle benefits, events, and concierge services offered to members, including access to exclusive experiences, third-party luxury providers, and travel enhancements beyond core aviation offerings. Delivered digitally and through partnerships.

products.name: Dual-Targeting CAR-T Cell Therapies
products.description: A portfolio of next-generation chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T) therapies, including autologous, allogeneic, and in vivo approaches, designed to target multiple tumor antigens for the treatment of hematologic malignancies, solid tumors, and immunology indications. These therapies are manufactured using either patient-derived or donor T cells, or delivered as nucleic acid formulations for in vivo modification.

products.name: Amezalpat (PPARα Antagonist)
products.description: An oral, small molecule selective antagonist of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha (PPARα), developed for the treatment of advanced solid tumors, particularly first-line unresectable or metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Manufactured as a pharmaceutical compound for oral administration, it is evaluated both as monotherapy and in combination with other agents.

products.name: TPST-1495 (Dual EP2/EP4 Prostaglandin Receptor Antagonist)
products.description: A potentially first-in-class, oral, small molecule dual antagonist of the prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) receptors EP2 and EP4, developed for the treatment of familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) and other cancers. Manufactured as a pharmaceutical compound for oral administration, evaluated as monotherapy and in combination with checkpoint inhibitors.

products.name: Unified Security Operations Platform (Command Platform)
products.description: A cloud-based, AI-driven platform integrating threat exposure, detection, and response capabilities, providing a unified view of vulnerabilities, exposures, and threats across endpoints, networks, and cloud environments. Delivered as SaaS and managed services, it centralizes security data and automates workflows for SecOps teams.

products.name: Managed Detection and Response (MDR) Services
products.description: 24x7 managed security services leveraging AI and human expertise to monitor, detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats across customer environments, including incident containment and breach response. Delivered by security analysts from global SOCs.

products.name: Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Extended Detection and Response (XDR)
products.description: Cloud-delivered SIEM and XDR solutions (e.g., Incident Command) that aggregate, analyze, and correlate security data from multiple sources to provide threat detection, investigation, and automated response, integrating threat intelligence and attack surface management.

products.name: Exposure Management Solutions
products.description: Software and managed services for attack surface management, vulnerability management, and proactive exposure mitigation, providing visibility and prioritization of security risks across hybrid, cloud, and on-premises environments. Includes Surface Command and Exposure Command offerings.

products.name: Cloud Security and Compliance Solutions
products.description: Cloud-native application protection and risk management solutions (CNAPP) that provide continuous security and compliance monitoring for cloud workloads and applications throughout the software development lifecycle.

products.name: Vulnerability Management Solutions
products.description: Software and managed services for identifying, assessing, and prioritizing vulnerabilities across on-premise and remote endpoints, including automated scanning and remediation guidance. Includes Rapid7 Vulnerability Management and Managed Vulnerability Management.

products.name: Application Security Solutions
products.description: Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) tools and managed services for identifying and remediating vulnerabilities in web and mobile applications, including expert guidance and validation. Delivered via cloud and supported by dedicated security advisors.

products.name: Threat Intelligence Services
products.description: Curated threat intelligence delivered via the platform, consolidating global threat data, actor context, and vulnerability insights to support detection, response, and digital risk protection, including monitoring of open, deep, and dark web sources.

products.name: Digital Risk Protection Services
products.description: Managed services providing expert monitoring of digital assets across the clear, deep, and dark web to detect threats such as data leaks, impersonation, and ransomware, with rapid takedown and incident response capabilities.

products.name: Red Teaming and Penetration Testing Services
products.description: Continuous red-teaming, exposure validation, and professional penetration testing services to assess and validate security defenses across networks, applications, IoT, and cloud environments, including compliance-driven testing and attack simulation.

products.name: Incident Response Services
products.description: Professional services to help organizations prepare for, respond to, and recover from cybersecurity incidents, including breach response, forensic investigation, and incident response program development.

products.name: Linebacker Platform (Small Molecule Therapeutics)
products.description: A platform of proprietary small molecule polyphenol compounds, developed through chemical modification of plant-derived flavonoids, intended for use as therapeutics in oncology, inflammatory disorders, and neurological diseases. Delivered via pharmaceutical manufacturing and distributed through licensing or direct sales.

products.name: Laetose (Alternative Sugar and Metabolic Health Product)
products.description: A patented sugar formulation designed to reduce caloric intake and glycemic index in foods, with potential applications as a consumer-packaged food ingredient or biopharmaceutical for metabolic and inflammatory diseases. Produced via proprietary formulation and offered through partnerships for commercialization.

products.name: Functional Fragrance Formulation (3F)
products.description: A suite of functional fragrances containing specialized botanical ingredients, developed for use as antimicrobials, insect repellents, and additives in consumer and industrial products such as detergents, lotions, and fabrics. Manufactured in partnership with fragrance companies and distributed for integration into various products.

products.name: Equivir Platform (Antiviral and Wellness Supplements)
products.description: A blend of FDA GRAS-eligible polyphenols formulated as antiviral agents, with applications as over-the-counter health supplements or medications for upper respiratory wellness. Developed for commercialization through licensing to pharmaceutical partners.

products.name: Celios Air Purification Technology
products.description: A patented, three-stage mechanical air filtration system capable of capturing ultrafine particles down to 10 nanometers, providing cleanroom-quality air for pathogen control. Manufactured as a physical device and distributed for use in healthcare and other environments.

products.name: AI-Powered Lending Marketplace
products.description: A digital platform that uses proprietary AI models to automate and improve the origination, underwriting, and pricing of unsecured and secured consumer loans, including personal loans, auto loans, and home equity lines of credit. Delivered via cloud-based software to consumers and lending partners, with high levels of automation and digital self-service.

products.name: Loan Servicing Services
products.description: Servicing of Upstart-powered loans for lending partners and institutional investors, including borrower communications, payment processing, collections, and regulatory compliance, delivered through a proprietary digital servicing platform.

products.name: Loan Sale and Securitization Programs
products.description: Programs enabling institutional investors to purchase whole loans or securities collateralized by Upstart-powered loans, including pass-through certificates and asset-backed securitizations, structured and managed by Upstart.

products.name: Auto Finance Software (Upstart Auto Finance)
products.description: A dealer-facing software-as-a-service application that modernizes the auto sales and financing process for auto dealerships and consumers, integrating Upstart’s AI-powered lending into automotive retail environments.

products.name: Virtual and Hybrid Event Services
products.description: Comprehensive planning, production, and broadcasting of virtual and hybrid events for corporate customers, delivered via proprietary web-based platforms (Xyvid Pro and TEN Pro) with interactive engagement tools, attendee management, and technical support. Services include event design, content creation, technical support, and post-event reporting.

products.name: Continuing Education Services for Events
products.description: Provision of live and asynchronous continuing education services as part of virtual and hybrid events, including qualification tracking, live polling, and certificate generation, primarily for professionally licensed industries. Delivered through proprietary platforms with integrated learning management features.

products.name: Physical Event Production and Broadcasting Services
products.description: Live streaming, video recording, editing, and production of physical (in-person) events, including creation of custom on-demand video libraries for clients. Requires on-site technicians, professional audio-visual equipment, and post-production services.

products.name: Self-Service Webcasting Platform (TEN Pro)
products.description: Subscription-based, self-service webcasting platform (TEN Pro) enabling enterprise customers to independently manage, produce, and broadcast their own virtual and hybrid events, with features such as AI-based captioning, translation, analytics, and on-demand editing. Delivered as a digital SaaS/PaaS product.

products.name: ATM and POS Transaction Processing Services
products.description: Provision and operation of Euronet-owned and outsourced ATMs and POS terminals, including cash withdrawal, deposit, and payment processing, as well as value-added services such as dynamic currency conversion, bill payment, and mobile top-up. Delivered via physical infrastructure and proprietary software, often under outsourcing contracts with financial institutions and merchants.

products.name: Prepaid and Digital Content Distribution Services
products.description: Distribution and processing of prepaid mobile airtime, gift cards (closed and open loop), prepaid debit cards, and digital media content (music, games, software) through a global POS network. Services are delivered via electronic connections to retailers and content providers, leveraging both physical and digital channels.

products.name: Global Money Transfer and Cross-Border Payment Services
products.description: Consumer-to-consumer and business-to-business money transfer and cross-border payment services, including real-time payments, account-to-account transfers, and alternative payout channels (bank accounts, cash pick-up, mobile wallets). Delivered through retail agents, company-owned stores, websites, and mobile apps, leveraging proprietary payment networks and platforms (Ria, Xe, Dandelion).

products.name: Electronic Payment and Transaction Processing Software Solutions
products.description: Licensing and delivery of integrated software platforms for electronic payments, transaction switching, card issuing, merchant acquiring, and ATM management. Solutions are provided as on-premise installations or SaaS offerings to financial institutions, central banks, and fintechs, supporting real-time and traditional payment networks.

products.name: Bill Payment and Related Financial Services
products.description: Processing of bill payments, money orders, check cashing, and related financial services for consumers, primarily through company-owned stores and select agents. Services are delivered via proprietary software and physical retail locations, often integrated with money transfer operations.

products.name: Foreign Currency Exchange and Risk Management Services
products.description: Provision of foreign currency exchange, currency information, and risk management solutions for consumers and small-to-medium businesses, delivered via web platforms, apps, and retail locations. Includes both informational services and execution of currency transactions.

products.name: Oil and Gas Royalty Interests
products.description: The Trust collects and distributes income derived from net overriding royalty interests in oil and gas production from underlying properties in Texas. This product is delivered through the legal structure of the trust, which receives cash flows from third-party operators who extract and sell hydrocarbons, requiring no physical manufacturing or direct operations by the Trust itself.

products.name: Fan Engagement and Rewards Platform
products.description: A proprietary business-to-business software platform that enables brands, sports teams, and event venues to offer in-game prizing and rewards (merchandise, coupons, digital goods, sweepstakes) through gamified experiences such as trivia, polls, and casual games. Delivered digitally via integration into websites, venues, or streaming content.

products.name: FFC (Filter Fan Cam) Platform
products.description: An augmented reality filtering tool for mobile and in-venue applications, used at live events, stadiums, arenas, and other entertainment venues to increase audience engagement through interactive games and branded experiences. Delivered as software integrated with venue video screens and digital platforms.

products.name: Winfinite Interactive Advertising Platform
products.description: A digital advertising tool that enables brands, agencies, and content creators to run interactive campaigns combining games and rewards to increase customer acquisition and loyalty. Delivered as a software platform compatible with multiple digital channels and integrated into advertising campaigns.

products.name: Winfinite Games Suite
products.description: A suite of customizable, lightweight web-based casual games (e.g., sports, match-3, trivia) that can be embedded in any web experience to enhance brand engagement. Delivered digitally as embeddable games for partners’ websites and campaigns.

products.name: Technology Licensing for Gamification and Engagement
products.description: Licensing of proprietary gamification, engagement, and QR code technology to third parties (e.g., ASPIS Cyber Technologies) for use in specific industries such as cybersecurity. Delivered as a software license with ongoing support and customization services.

products.name: Land-Based Drilling Services
products.description: Provision of land-based drilling rigs and crews for oil and natural gas wells, including rig operation, maintenance, and associated drilling services. Requires physical manufacturing, skilled labor, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Offshore Platform Drilling Services
products.description: Provision of offshore platform drilling rigs and crews for oil and natural gas wells, including rig operation and maintenance in offshore environments. Requires specialized equipment, skilled labor, and compliance with offshore regulations.

products.name: Drilling Automation and Performance Software
products.description: Development and deployment of proprietary software platforms and automation systems that enhance drilling performance, safety, and efficiency for both Nabors and third-party rigs. Delivered digitally and integrated with physical rig operations.

products.name: Directional Drilling and Steering Systems
products.description: Provision of advanced directional drilling technologies and steering control systems, including hardware and software, to optimize wellbore placement and drilling efficiency. Delivered as integrated solutions on rigs.

products.name: Tubular Running Services (TRS)
products.description: Provision of casing and tubing running services, including torque monitoring and automation, integrated into rig operations to improve efficiency and safety. Requires specialized equipment and skilled labor.

products.name: Managed Pressure Drilling (MPD) Services
products.description: Provision of managed pressure drilling services and equipment, enabling drilling in challenging formations by controlling wellbore pressure. Delivered as an integrated service with proprietary software and hardware.

products.name: Advanced Drilling Equipment and Rig Components
products.description: Manufacture and sale of advanced rig components and drilling equipment, such as top drives, catwalks, wrenches, drawworks, robotic systems, and downhole tools, for both onshore and offshore rigs. Requires physical manufacturing and engineering.

products.name: Aftermarket Equipment Sales and Services
products.description: Provision of aftermarket sales and support services for installed rig equipment, including maintenance, repair, and parts supply. Requires technical service teams and logistics.

products.name: Energy Transition and Emissions Reduction Technologies
products.description: Development and sale of technologies and solutions for energy efficiency, emissions monitoring, engine management, energy storage, hydrogen, and carbon capture, targeting both Nabors and third-party customers. Delivered as hardware, software, and integrated solutions.

products.name: Digital Identity Validation Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions that validate both digital and physical identities for KYC, fraud prevention, and age verification, delivered via mobile devices, browsers, or retail point-of-sale scanners. Includes proprietary technology for reading and authenticating government-issued IDs and integrating biometric and risk analysis features.

products.name: Identity Document Reading and Authentication Software
products.description: Software that reads, decodes, and authenticates government-issued identification documents (driver's licenses, non-driver IDs, passports, military IDs) using barcode and magnetic stripe data, available as standalone applications or integrated via SDK/API into customer systems.

products.name: Instant Credit Application Kiosk Software
products.description: Custom software applications for financial service companies and retail stores that enable in-store instant credit approval by scanning and verifying IDs at kiosks, populating application forms, and integrating with backend credit decisioning systems.

products.name: Access Control and Security Solutions
products.description: Software and systems designed to increase security and control access to sensitive locations (airports, ports, military installations, high-profile buildings) by authenticating identification documents and matching individuals to their IDs, often integrating biometric verification.

products.name: Age Verification Solutions
products.description: Software solutions that validate government-issued IDs to confirm the age of customers purchasing age-restricted products (alcohol, cannabis, tobacco, gambling), delivered via mobile, POS, or online platforms.

products.name: Fraud Prevention and Risk Scoring Services
products.description: Services that analyze identity document data and additional signals (device fingerprinting, IP address, phone number, etc.) using machine learning to assess the risk of fraud in transactions, integrated into the identity validation platform.

products.name: Productivity Enhancement and Data Entry Automation Software
products.description: Software that automates the population of forms and applications by reading encoded data from IDs, reducing manual data entry errors and increasing throughput for commercial and government clients.

products.name: Apitegromab
products.description: Apitegromab is a fully human monoclonal antibody that inhibits myostatin activation by selectively binding the pro- and latent forms of myostatin in skeletal muscle. It is produced using proprietary antibody discovery and manufacturing processes and is delivered via intravenous or subcutaneous injection. It is being developed for the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA), facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD), and other rare neuromuscular diseases, as well as for preservation of lean mass during GLP-1-induced weight loss.

products.name: SRK-439
products.description: SRK-439 is a novel, investigational, subcutaneously administered fully human anti-pro/latent myostatin antibody with high inhibitory potency and selectivity for myostatin. It is produced using proprietary antibody technology and is being developed for the treatment of rare, severe, and debilitating neuromuscular diseases, including potential use in combination with GLP-1 therapies for preservation of lean mass during weight loss.

products.name: SRK-181
products.description: SRK-181 is a highly selective inhibitor of latent TGFβ1, produced as a monoclonal antibody, and is in development for the treatment of advanced solid tumors that are resistant to anti-PD-(L)1 antibody therapies. It is administered via injection and is intended for use in combination with checkpoint inhibitor therapies in oncology.

products.name: SRK-373
products.description: SRK-373 is an investigational, highly selective inhibitor of the latent TGFβ1 isoform, designed to selectively inhibit TGFβ1 activation within the fibrotic extracellular matrix. It is in preclinical development for the treatment of fibrotic diseases and is produced using proprietary antibody discovery and manufacturing processes.

products.name: SRK-256
products.description: SRK-256 is a highly selective and potent inhibitor of RGMc (hemojuvelin), produced as a monoclonal antibody, in preclinical development for the treatment of iron-restricted anemias. It is designed to modulate iron homeostasis by targeting the co-receptor predominantly expressed in the liver.

products.name: Data Center Accelerated Computing and Networking Platforms
products.description: Integrated hardware and software platforms for data centers, including GPUs, CPUs, DPUs, networking components, and full software stacks, delivered as rack-scale systems, subsystems, or modules for AI, HPC, and other compute-intensive workloads. Requires advanced semiconductor manufacturing, system integration, and enterprise software development.

products.name: Enterprise AI Software Suites
products.description: Comprehensive enterprise-grade AI software, including NVIDIA AI Enterprise, vGPU, and domain-specific frameworks, delivered as paid licenses to enable development, deployment, and management of AI applications on NVIDIA-accelerated infrastructure. Delivered digitally and requires ongoing software engineering and support.

products.name: GPUs for Gaming and Consumer PCs
products.description: Discrete graphics processing units (GPUs) for gaming desktops and laptops, including GeForce RTX series, leveraging advanced rendering and AI technologies. Requires semiconductor manufacturing and is distributed through OEMs, ODMs, and retail channels.

products.name: Cloud Gaming Services
products.description: Cloud-based gaming platforms, primarily GeForce NOW, providing remote access to high-performance gaming experiences via streaming from NVIDIA-powered data centers. Delivered as a subscription digital service.

products.name: Professional Visualization GPUs and Platforms
products.description: GPUs and software platforms (e.g., RTX PRO, Quadro/NVIDIA RTX) for professional visualization, design, engineering, and digital content creation, optimized for leading 3D and creative applications. Requires advanced hardware and software integration, sold through partners and OEMs.

products.name: Automotive Computing Platforms for Autonomous and Electric Vehicles
products.description: End-to-end hardware and software platforms for automotive applications, including DRIVE Hyperion and DRIVE AGX, providing computing, sensor integration, and AI-based software for autonomous driving, mapping, parking, and in-vehicle experiences. Delivered as embedded systems and software to automotive OEMs and suppliers.

products.name: Networking Products and Solutions
products.description: Networking hardware and software for data centers, including NVLink interconnects, InfiniBand and Ethernet platforms, network adapters, DPUs, switch chips and systems, and related software. Requires semiconductor and systems manufacturing and is sold to hyperscalers, OEMs, and enterprises.

products.name: Open and Proprietary AI Models and Model Platforms
products.description: Open and proprietary AI models and model platforms (e.g., Nemotron, Cosmos, NeMo) provided to enterprises and developers for building, fine-tuning, and deploying generative and agentic AI applications. Delivered digitally and supported by NVIDIA’s infrastructure and software ecosystem.

products.name: Embedded Computing Modules and SoCs
products.description: Embedded computing modules and system-on-chips (SoCs) for use in gaming devices, automotive, robotics, and other edge applications, providing high-performance, energy-efficient processing. Requires semiconductor design and manufacturing, sold to OEMs and device manufacturers.

products.name: 3D Design Collaboration and Simulation Software (Omniverse)
products.description: Omniverse, a real-time 3D design collaboration and virtual world simulation software platform, enabling artists, designers, and creators to connect and collaborate in leading design applications. Delivered as a digital software platform requiring ongoing development and support.

products.name: Immunology Therapies
products.description: Biologic and small molecule therapies for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, including rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, and related conditions. These are manufactured through advanced biotechnological processes and delivered via injection or oral administration.

products.name: Neuroscience Therapies
products.description: Pharmaceutical and biologic treatments for neurologic and psychiatric disorders such as schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, migraine, Parkinson's disease, and spasticity. These products are delivered as oral medications, injectables, or infusion therapies.

products.name: Oncology Therapies
products.description: Targeted therapies for blood cancers and solid tumors, including oral small molecules, antibody-drug conjugates, and biologics. These products are manufactured using advanced pharmaceutical and biotechnological methods and are administered orally or via injection/infusion.

products.name: Aesthetics Products
products.description: A portfolio of facial injectables, dermal fillers, regenerative medicine, body contouring devices, breast implants, and skincare products. These are manufactured medical devices and topical or injectable products, delivered through healthcare professionals or direct to consumers.

products.name: Eye Care Products
products.description: Pharmaceutical therapies and medical devices for the treatment of glaucoma, ocular hypertension, macular edema, uveitis, and dry eye. These include implants, topical solutions, and other ophthalmic products, manufactured under strict regulatory standards.

products.name: Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) Therapies
products.description: Oral antiviral combination therapies for the treatment of chronic and acute hepatitis C virus infection, manufactured as small molecule pharmaceuticals and distributed globally.

products.name: Pancreatic Enzyme Therapy
products.description: Enzyme replacement therapy for exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, produced as oral capsules and sold primarily in the United States.

products.name: Gastrointestinal Therapies
products.description: Oral therapies for irritable bowel syndrome with constipation and chronic idiopathic constipation, manufactured as small molecule pharmaceuticals and distributed in the US and internationally.

products.name: Private Market Trading Platform
products.description: A technology-driven platform that connects buyers and sellers of private company shares, facilitating direct secondary transfers, fund investments, and providing a centralized interface for order management, negotiation, and transaction closing. Delivered digitally via web applications and APIs, with compliance and regulatory support integrated.

products.name: Private Company Liquidity and Capital Solutions
products.description: Tailored solutions for private companies to manage liquidity events, including software for tender offer programs, structured employee liquidity programs, and facilitation of capital raising through primary financings and tender offers. Delivered via proprietary software and direct engagement with companies.

products.name: Asset Management Services (Single Asset Funds)
products.description: Management of Single Asset Funds (SAFs) that invest in private companies, providing structured access to private market opportunities for investors. Includes fund creation, management, and redemption, with assets held in LLCs or Cayman Island funds. Delivered through a registered investment adviser subsidiary.

products.name: Private Market Data and Analytics
products.description: Provision of proprietary aggregated and derived data on private market transactions, company information, pricing indications (Forge Price), and indices (FPMI, FAPMI) for research, analysis, and benchmarking. Delivered digitally via platform interfaces and APIs.

products.name: Custodial Services for Alternative Assets
products.description: Custody services for self-directed retirement accounts (SDIRAs) and alternative assets such as private stock, private equity, real estate, and precious metals, provided through a non-depository trust company. Includes cloud-based custody platform and Custody-as-a-Service APIs for integration with third-party platforms.

products.name: Stock Option Exercise Lending
products.description: Non-recourse loans with deferred interest to private company employees to facilitate the exercise of stock options in connection with sales on the Forge marketplace. Delivered through a licensed lending subsidiary.

products.name: Nursing and Health Professions Education Programs
products.description: Degree and certificate programs in nursing and health professions, including pre-licensure and post-licensure BSN, MSN, DNP, nurse practitioner tracks, public health, social work, and physician assistant studies, delivered via onsite campuses and online platforms.

products.name: Online Higher Education Programs for Working Professionals
products.description: Online bachelor’s, master’s, and doctoral degree and certificate programs across disciplines such as nursing, education, counseling, business, information technology, psychology, public health, social work, human services, public administration, public policy, and criminal justice, primarily delivered through distance learning modalities.

products.name: Medical Education Programs (Doctor of Medicine)
products.description: Doctor of Medicine degree programs delivered by American University of the Caribbean School of Medicine and Ross University School of Medicine, including basic science instruction and clinical rotations at affiliated hospitals in the U.S., Canada, and the U.K.

products.name: Veterinary Medicine Education Programs
products.description: Doctor of Veterinary Medicine, Master of Science, and Ph.D. degree programs delivered by Ross University School of Veterinary Medicine, including pre-clinical curriculum at the St. Kitts campus and clinical clerkships at affiliated institutions in the U.S. and abroad.

products.name: Automotive Replacement Parts
products.description: New and remanufactured automotive hard parts such as engines, starters, alternators, fuel pumps, and radiators are physically stocked and sold through retail stores, commercial delivery, and online platforms. These require extensive inventory management and distribution infrastructure.

products.name: Automotive Maintenance Items
products.description: Consumable products for vehicle upkeep, such as fluids, filters, spark plugs, wipers, and chemicals, are sold through stores and online, requiring physical inventory and distribution.

products.name: Automotive Accessories
products.description: A wide range of interior and exterior accessories, including floor mats, seat covers, electronics, and performance products, are sold in stores and online, requiring physical inventory and merchandising.

products.name: Non-Automotive Products
products.description: Products not directly related to automotive use, such as drinks, snacks, and general merchandise, are sold in stores as ancillary offerings, requiring physical inventory and retail display.

products.name: Commercial Sales Program
products.description: Wholesale distribution of automotive parts and products to professional customers (repair shops, dealers, fleet owners) with prompt delivery and commercial credit, leveraging dedicated sales teams and expanded inventory at hub stores.

products.name: Online Retail Sales
products.description: E-commerce sales of automotive parts, maintenance items, accessories, and non-automotive products through AutoZone's websites and mobile applications, with options for home delivery or in-store pickup, requiring digital infrastructure and logistics integration.

products.name: Automotive Diagnostic, Repair, and Shop Management Software (ALLDATA)
products.description: Digital software products under the ALLDATA brand, including automotive diagnostic, repair, collision, and shop management solutions, are sold online to professional customers, requiring software development and digital delivery.

products.name: Specialty Tool Lending (Loan-A-Tool Program)
products.description: A service allowing customers to borrow specialty automotive tools for temporary use, requiring inventory of tools and in-store management, offered as a free value-added service to drive customer traffic.

products.name: Sportswear and Outerwear Manufacturing
products.description: Manufacture and export of customized, ready-made sportswear and outerwear (including jackets, polo shirts, t-shirts, pants, shorts, and vests) from knitted fabric at company-owned and operated factories in Jordan. Products are produced through physical manufacturing processes including cutting, embroidery, sewing, finishing, quality control, ironing, and packing, and are sold to major global brands and retailers.

products.name: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Products
products.description: Manufacture and trading of personal protective equipment (PPE) products, produced at dedicated facilities in Jordan and traded through subsidiaries. This includes physical manufacturing and distribution of PPE items to external customers.

products.name: Cooltrans Technology Fiber and Fabric Supply
products.description: Supply of fiber and fabric printed with Cooltrans technology, delivered through a joint venture. This involves sourcing and providing technologically enhanced textile materials to external customers.

products.name: RNS System
products.description: A brain-responsive neuromodulation system for the treatment of drug-resistant epilepsy, consisting of implantable and external components (neurostimulator, leads, Patient Remote Monitor, Physician Tablet, PDMS, and nSight Platform). The system is physically manufactured, surgically implanted, and supported by digital data management and remote monitoring capabilities.

products.name: RNS System Replacement Devices
products.description: Replacement neurostimulators for the RNS System, provided when the implanted device reaches end of battery life. These are physically manufactured medical devices, surgically implanted as replacements, and represent a recurring revenue stream.

products.name: RNS System Data Monitoring and Analysis Services
products.description: Digital services provided to clinicians and third parties, including access to the PDMS and nSight Platform for ongoing patient monitoring, data review, and AI-driven analysis of brain activity. These services are delivered digitally and support remote and in-person patient management.

products.name: Distribution of DIXI Medical Stereo EEG Products (U.S., through 2025)
products.description: Distribution of DIXI Medical’s stereo electroencephalography (Stereo EEG) product line in the United States, used in epilepsy monitoring units to determine seizure origin. These are physical medical devices distributed to hospitals and clinics.

products.name: RNS System Data Collaboration Services
products.description: Provision of data and biomarker monitoring/analysis services to third-party partners (e.g., pharmaceutical companies) using the RNS System’s unique data set and analytics capabilities to support clinical trials and research. Delivered as a digital service leveraging proprietary data and analytics.

products.name: Analog and Mixed-Signal Integrated Circuits (ICs)
products.description: High-performance analog and mixed-signal ICs, including data converters, amplifiers, and signal conditioning devices, manufactured using proprietary semiconductor processes and delivered as components for integration into electronic systems across various industries.

products.name: Power Management and Reference ICs
products.description: Integrated circuits for power conversion, energy management, voltage regulation, and driver monitoring, delivered as standalone components or system-level solutions for efficient power management in automotive, industrial, communications, and consumer applications.

products.name: RF and Microwave ICs
products.description: High-performance radio frequency (RF) and microwave integrated circuits, including amplifiers and signal chain components, designed and manufactured for use in cellular infrastructure, instrumentation, aerospace, automotive, and communications systems.

products.name: Sensors and Actuators (including MEMS)
products.description: A portfolio of sensor and actuator products, including MEMS-based accelerometers, gyroscopes, inertial measurement units, temperature and magnetic sensors, and isolators, manufactured using specialized semiconductor processes and supplied as components for integration into electronic systems.

products.name: Digital Signal Processors (DSPs) and System Products
products.description: Programmable digital signal processor ICs and system-level products optimized for high-speed numeric calculations and real-time processing of digitized data, delivered as components or modules for integration into customer systems.

products.name: Interface ICs
products.description: General-purpose analog ICs designed to modify, shape, and ensure the integrity of signals for transmission over physical media, delivered as components for use in electronic systems requiring robust signal transmission and reception.

products.name: Software, Digital Platforms, and AI Solutions
products.description: Software platforms, digital design tools, and AI-driven solutions, such as CodeFusion Studio and Power Studio, provided to support embedded system design, signal processing, power management, and system integration for customers using ADI hardware.

products.name: Unified SMB SaaS Platform
products.description: A cloud-based, modular software platform integrating CRM, marketing execution, workflow automation, communications, payments, and reporting for small and medium-sized businesses. Delivered digitally via subscription and designed for daily use by business owners and operators.

products.name: Marketing Center
products.description: A suite of digital marketing tools within the SaaS platform, including social media management, online presence optimization, analytics, lead attribution, competitor tracking, and content scheduling. Delivered digitally as part of the platform or as an extension.

products.name: CRM and Automation Engine (Keap)
products.description: A CRM and automation solution for managing contacts, automating sales and marketing workflows, sales pipelines, communications, and email marketing. Delivered digitally as part of the unified SaaS platform.

products.name: Payment Solutions (ThryvPay and KeapPay)
products.description: Branded payment processing solutions enabling SMBs to accept credit card and ACH payments, schedule payments, manage surcharges, and offer consumer financing. Integrated into the SaaS platform and delivered digitally.

products.name: Platform Extensions and Integrations
products.description: Optional add-ons and integrations for the SaaS platform, including lead generation (Thryv Leads), SEO tools, website creation and management, and growth packages. Delivered digitally to enhance platform functionality.

products.name: Professional Services (Implementation, Training, Consulting)
products.description: Implementation, onboarding, training, and consulting services to help clients maximize value from the SaaS platform, including strategic content creation and ongoing consulting. Delivered by in-person or remote human labor.

products.name: Vertical SaaS Solutions (e.g., Thryv for HVAC)
products.description: Industry-specific SaaS solutions tailored for verticals such as HVAC, addressing unique marketing, lead conversion, and customer retention needs. Delivered digitally as specialized modules or packages within the platform.

products.name: Print Marketing Solutions (Print Yellow and White Pages)
products.description: Legacy print directory advertising services, including Yellow and White Pages, published and distributed to targeted households. Requires physical manufacturing and distribution of printed directories.

products.name: Digital Marketing Services (Internet Yellow Pages, Extended Search, SEM, Digital Media)
products.description: Legacy digital marketing services including Internet Yellow Pages, extended search solutions, search engine marketing, online display and social advertising, and SEO tools. Delivered via proprietary and third-party digital platforms.

products.name: Direct Lending to Middle-Market Companies
products.description: Origination and provision of senior secured loans, unsecured loans, subordinated loans, and mezzanine loans to U.S. middle-market companies, primarily through direct negotiation and structuring by in-house investment professionals. Delivery requires significant financial capital, credit analysis, and regulatory compliance as a business development company.

products.name: Broadly Syndicated Loans
products.description: Investment in and participation in broadly syndicated loans originated and structured by banks for large corporate borrowers, including both primary and secondary market transactions. These are financial products requiring capital allocation and expertise in loan syndication and credit markets.

products.name: Equity and Equity-Related Investments
products.description: Provision of capital to portfolio companies through investments in common equity, preferred equity, warrants, and similar equity-linked securities, typically as a minority investor. These investments are made alongside or in addition to debt investments and require financial structuring and ongoing portfolio monitoring.

products.name: Specialty Finance Solutions
products.description: Provision of asset-based loans, equipment financing, life insurance-based assets, royalty interests, and other specialty finance products through investments in specialty finance portfolio companies. These solutions require specialized underwriting, asset management, and regulatory expertise.

products.name: Joint Venture Investments in Credit and Leasing
products.description: Participation in joint ventures that invest in senior secured loans, broadly syndicated loans, collateralized loan obligations, and equipment leases and loans. These are structured as co-managed entities with other institutional partners and require financial capital and joint governance.

products.name: Next-Generation Autologous CAR T-Cell Therapies for Hematologic Malignancies
products.description: Proprietary, autologous (patient-derived) chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapies, including dual-targeting CD19/CD20 CAR T-cell products, manufactured using enhanced protocols to enrich for naïve and central memory T cells, designed to treat hematologic cancers such as large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL) and other non-Hodgkin lymphoma subtypes. These therapies are produced through genetic engineering and ex vivo cell processing in a dedicated cGMP facility.

products.name: Next-Generation Autologous CAR T-Cell Therapies for Solid Tumors
products.description: Proprietary autologous CAR T-cell therapies targeting solid tumors, including products such as LYL273 (GCC-targeted CAR T-cell therapy for metastatic colorectal cancer), enhanced with additional CAR constructs and controlled cytokine release to improve cell expansion, tumor infiltration, and cancer cell killing. These therapies are manufactured using automated, scalable processes and incorporate multiple engineered cell types for improved efficacy in the hostile tumor microenvironment.

products.name: Fleet Payment Solutions
products.description: Provides payment processing, transaction management, and information services for commercial vehicle fleets, including fuel and EV charging payments, via proprietary closed-loop networks and SaaS platforms. Delivered through physical and digital cards, software, and integrated reporting tools.

products.name: Fleet Management Software and Analytics
products.description: Offers SaaS solutions for field service management, telematics, reporting, analytics, cash flow management, and mixed-energy fleet optimization, delivered digitally to help fleets manage operations, costs, and sustainability.

products.name: Freight Invoice Factoring
products.description: Provides freight invoice factoring services to trucking customers, offering short-term financing by purchasing accounts receivable, primarily for over-the-road fleets.

products.name: Employee Benefits Administration Solutions
products.description: Delivers SaaS-based software and administrative services for employee benefits, including tax-advantaged accounts (HSAs, FSAs, HRAs), COBRA, direct billing, enrollment, and compliance, integrating payment processing and data-driven insights. Delivered digitally and via payment cards.

products.name: Non-Bank Custodial Services for Health Accounts
products.description: Provides custody, cash management, and depository services for health savings accounts (HSAs) and other benefit accounts, leveraging WEX Bank and IRS non-bank custodian status. Involves regulated financial infrastructure and investment management.

products.name: Global B2B Virtual Payment Solutions
products.description: Offers global business-to-business payment solutions, primarily through virtual cards and embedded payments, integrating with customer and partner workflows for accounts payable automation, supplier payments, and spend management. Delivered via cloud-based platforms and APIs.

products.name: Accounts Payable Automation Software
products.description: Provides SaaS platforms and integrations for automating accounts payable processes, including ERP integration, supplier enablement, and payment execution via virtual cards, bank transfers, and checks. Delivered digitally to businesses and financial institutions.

products.name: Senior Secured Debt Investments
products.description: Origination and purchase of senior secured first lien loans, second lien loans, and unitranche loans to private U.S. middle-market companies, typically involving direct lending and active portfolio management. These are physically originated and managed financial products requiring significant due diligence and ongoing monitoring.

products.name: Unsecured Debt Investments
products.description: Provision and purchase of unsecured debt instruments, including corporate bonds and subordinated (mezzanine) loans, to private and thinly-traded U.S. middle-market companies. These are financial products requiring capital and credit expertise, and are managed through direct origination or secondary market purchases.

products.name: Equity and Equity-Related Investments
products.description: Non-control investments in preferred or common equity, as well as equity-related securities such as warrants or options, typically made in conjunction with debt investments or as co-investments with financial sponsors. These are financial investments requiring capital and are often structured alongside debt products.

products.name: Collateralized Securities and Structured Products
products.description: Investments in collateralized securities and structured products, including CDOs, CBOs, CLOs, structured notes, and credit-linked notes, typically through the purchase of securities issued by special purpose vehicles. These are financial products requiring capital and expertise in structured finance.

products.name: Short-Term Investments
products.description: Investments in highly liquid instruments with average original maturity dates of three months or less, typically through funds or repurchase agreements, used for liquidity management and temporary allocation of capital.
